package main

import "fmt"

type T struct{}

func ordinary(a int, b string, c ...int) {
	fmt.Println("ordinary", a, b, c)
}

func (T) method(int) {
	fmt.Println("method")
}

func (T) String() string {
	return "String"
}

func blank(_ int, _ ...int) {
	fmt.Println("blank")
}

var __bpp0_unnamed0 = "unnamed"
var _unnamed0 = "unnamed2"

func main() {
	ordinary(1, "b", 2, 3)
	T{}.method(4)
	fmt.Println(T{}.String())
	blank(5, 6, 7)
	
	func(a int) {
		fmt.Println(__bpp0_unnamed0, _unnamed0)
	}(8)
}
